diagrams.title: Each block is one LLM call, and both rows use the same clock
diagrams.caption: Each block is one LLM call, and both rows use the same clock. The four-line version isn't doing less work — it finishes a quarter of the way along because the same 12 blocks are stacked four deep instead of laid end to end.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 940 300" aria-label="Two arrangements drawn to the same time scale. Twelve calls on one line stretches across eighteen seconds. The same twelve split across four lines of three finishes at four and a half seconds, a quarter of the way along." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <defs>
          <pattern id="callsR" width="65" height="30" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse" patternTransform="translate(100,0)">
            <rect x="0" y="0" width="61" height="30" fill="#8A5E12"></rect>
          </pattern>
        </defs>
        <text x="100" y="34" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" font-size="11" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".08em" fill="currentColor">ONE LINE — 12 calls back to back</text>
        <rect x="100" y="44" width="780" height="28" fill="url(#callsR)"></rect>
        <text x="886" y="63" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="currentColor">18 s</text>
        <text x="100" y="108" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" font-size="11" font-weight="600" letter-spacing=".08em" fill="currentColor">FOUR LINES — 3 calls each, all running at once</text>
        <text x="92" y="132" text-anchor="end" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" font-size="10" fill="currentColor" opacity=".7">A</text>
        <rect x="100" y="116" width="195" height="20" fill="url(#callsR)"></rect>
        <text x="92" y="158" text-anchor="end" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" font-size="10" fill="currentColor" opacity=".7">B</text>
        <rect x="100" y="142" width="195" height="20" fill="url(#callsR)"></rect>
        <text x="92" y="184" text-anchor="end" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" font-size="10" fill="currentColor" opacity=".7">C</text>
        <rect x="100" y="168" width="195" height="20" fill="url(#callsR)"></rect>
        <text x="92" y="210" text-anchor="end" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" font-size="10" fill="currentColor" opacity=".7">D</text>
        <rect x="100" y="194" width="195" height="20" fill="url(#callsR)"></rect>
        <line x1="295" y1="110" x2="295" y2="238" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5 4"></line>
        <text x="309" y="162" font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="currentColor">all four done at 4.5 s</text>
        <text x="309" y="182" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="currentColor" opacity=".72">— four times faster, same 12 calls</text>
        <line x1="100" y1="238" x2="880" y2="238" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1" opacity=".4"></line>
        <g font-family="IBM Plex Mono, monospace" font-size="10" fill="currentColor" opacity=".65">
          <line x1="100" y1="238" x2="100" y2="244" stroke="currentColor" opacity=".5"></line><text x="100" y="260" text-anchor="middle">0s</text>
          <line x1="295" y1="238" x2="295" y2="244" stroke="currentColor" opacity=".5"></line><text x="295" y="260" text-anchor="middle">4.5s</text>
          <line x1="490" y1="238" x2="490" y2="244" stroke="currentColor" opacity=".5"></line><text x="490" y="260" text-anchor="middle">9s</text>
          <line x1="880" y1="238" x2="880" y2="244" stroke="currentColor" opacity=".5"></line><text x="880" y="260" text-anchor="middle">18s</text>
        </g>
        <text x="490" y="288" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Public Sans, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="currentColor" opacity=".75">Both arrangements hold exactly 12 calls. Only the shape changed.</text>
      </svg>

diagrams.title: The counter clerk (REST API) takes the complaint, writes it down, drops the ticket on the pile, and hands you a receipt in 50 ms
diagrams.caption: The counter clerk (REST API) takes the complaint, writes it down, drops the ticket on the pile, and hands you a receipt in 50 ms. Workers pull from the pile when they have capacity. The ledger is how the app answers “is it ready yet?” — and how a crashed worker finds its place again.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 980 400" aria-label="Production architecture. The app posts a dispute to a thin API which stores it and enqueues the id. A bounded pool of worker nodes polls the queue and runs fourteen LLM calls per dispute against one or more providers. Both the API and the workers write to a shared ledger below, the workers checkpointing after every stage. The app polls the API for status." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <defs>
          <marker id="ar3" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6.5" markerHeight="6.5" orient="auto-start-reverse">
